text: Participating in the pool offers an active method for maintaining fitness while providing relief from summer heat. Learning to swim laps or navigate a pool requires minimal time and effort. Nevertheless, failing to use goggles may result in significant ocular damage. Eye protection is essential to shield against damaging ultraviolet light and stop irritation from developing. Perform a proper warm-up session prior to entering the water, and consume ample fluid before you start, while swimming, and immediately afterward.
